title: The path to your purpose isn't always paved with popular approval. There will be moments when your conviction clashes with the expectations of others. In those moments, remember whose voice truly matters in your life's direction. Your peace is paramount.
paragraphs: The path to your purpose isn't always paved with popular approval. There will be moments when your conviction clashes with the expectations of others. In those moments, remember whose voice truly matters in your life's direction. Your peace is paramount.

"Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will." - Romans 12:2
